prose:
An Antigravity user investigates whether short prompt-cache persistence contributes to rapid quota use. The examined opening describes reverse engineering and empirical probing rather than merely inferring the cause from a high bill.

This summary does not validate the later measurements or suggested keep-alive changes. Findings from one version and account need not transfer, and undocumented modifications can alter support, security and billing behavior. No binaries or caching settings were changed.
highlights: Account and software version constrain transfer
Later measurements were not independently reproduced
No modification or keep-alive setup was performed
